import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('tests/codegen/arrays/indexed/sorting.rs')
t = p.read_text()
old = '''        out.stdout.contains("krsort()")
            && out.stdout.contains("Argument #1")
            && out.stdout.contains("array"),'''
new = '''        // The fatal travels on the DIAGNOSTIC stream, which is php's stdout: the harness splits
        // that one stream into the program's own output and the diagnostics, and a program whose
        // only output is the fatal has an EMPTY `stdout`.
        out.diagnostics.contains("krsort()")
            && out.diagnostics.contains("Argument #1")
            && out.diagnostics.contains("array"),'''
assert t.count(old) == 3, t.count(old)
t = t.replace(old, new)
# the message argument beneath each assertion prints the same stream
t = t.replace('''        "expected a controlled krsort array TypeError, got: {}",
        out.stdout,''', '''        "expected a controlled krsort array TypeError, got: {}",
        out.diagnostics,''')
p.write_text(t)
print('sorting.rs: three fatals read the diagnostic stream')
